purpose: Two-slot source-only development pilot for exhaustive rally references, without predictions or model access

selection.rule: First native frame at or after each source-PTS grid point relative to original origin; clamp to final ordinal only when needed, retaining duplicate memberships
selection.candidate_rule: Earliest service-preparation overview followed by exchange and stopped-play within40 source seconds, separately independently assessed and source-adjudicated before dense preparation
selection.failed_slot: Retain unresolved/unavailable slot; never replace an invalidated or unsupported candidate with an easier rally
selection.screening_limit: Sparse overviews propose bounds; they do not certify complete rallies or exact events

assessment.coverage: Every selected native frame in two actual independent streams; separate fresh source-only adjudication; original outputs, disagreements, session/image receipts and own-stream continuity retained
assessment.contacts: Inclusive uncertainty intervals for observed or unresolved racket contacts; opening serve occurs once, with no shot family; terminal evidence has its own interval and is not the last stroke
assessment.actors: Source actors with descriptions and unknown identity links, independently of tracker IDs, court end or screen position
assessment.unknowns: Keep missing, corrupt, censored, uncertain, unreviewed and unknown cases. Unknown is not a negative and agreement is not expert gold truth
assessment.complete_reference: Supported exhaustive contact enumeration, known source hitters, live camera context and observed service/terminal boundaries; no unresolved contact, identity or boundary gap inside the provisional rally
assessment.label_support: Family/side remain unknown unless source mechanics and outgoing flight warrant them; half smash excluded; unknown labels do not establish strict full annotation accuracy

payload.images: Unmodified oriented original source-frame PNGs only
payload.context: Minimal public protocol/frame/hash context and the same stream's own continuity notes; no predictions, model outputs, other-stream assessments or account secrets
